title: Add hierarchy-aware padding to nested Topology containers
description: Keep nested Container Boundary labels and child regions visually separated in Topology view without sample-specific coordinates.
completion_criteria: Direct child Containers reserve a readable parent label band.
Parent-child side and bottom padding is deterministic and depth-aware.
Sibling Container non-overlap clearance is preserved.
Expanded Container geometry remains inside the golden-ratio canvas.
Focused tests, typecheck, build, QIF evidence, and browser verification pass.
evidence: Focused topology regression passed 18 tests; typecheck and production build passed.
Browser smoke confirmed visible Production Cloud -> Production VPC -> Subnet hierarchy spacing.
notes: The layout derives padding from Container nesting depth. Direct child spacing is 32 units at the top and 20 units on the remaining sides; sibling clearance remains 24 units.
